question: Early on Friday morning a paper mill had 213 reels in the yard and took delivery of 53 more before the shift began. Through the morning every reel in the yard was cut down into 8 large sheets. During the afternoon 683 sheets were rejected for creases and sent back to the pulper. In the evening the printers ruled each remaining sheet into 7 columns, and every column was then divided into 7 rows of boxes. A dozen delivery bikes waited at the gate for the night run. How many boxes were ruled in total?

A library trolley held 210 returned books when the staff arrived on Monday. A shelver put 53 of them back on the shelves during the morning, and 4 were pulled off the trolley with broken spines. Over the rest of the week readers returned 40 more books to the trolley, a school dropped off 68, and a house clearance donated 80. The library opens for 9 hours a day in the summer. How many books are sitting on the trolley now?

Early on Saturday morning Ines picked 122 plums from the tree behind her house and kept half of them, sending the rest round to her neighbour. Before lunch she used 33 of her own plums to make a pot of jam. In the early afternoon a friend arrived with 27 plums from his garden for her. Later that afternoon she sold 47 plums at the roadside table by the gate. In the evening her daughter came home with 5 more from the market. The price card on the roadside table is written in cents rather than dollars. How many plums does Ines have at the end of the day?

A cycle shop's workshop had 79 inner tubes on the rack, and a wholesaler's van delivered 64 more. The wholesaler then recalled 111 tubes because of a faulty valve batch. The tubes that were left were split equally between the shop's 2 branches. The high street branch used 10 of its tubes on repairs that week and afterwards received 73 more from a closing-down sale down the road. The shop's stock sheet counts single tubes rather than sealed cartons. How many inner tubes does the high street branch have?

Early on Saturday morning a bakery pulled 217 trays out of the oven, with 5 buns on every tray. Through the rest of the morning 661 buns were sold across the counter. In the afternoon a second bake added 73 buns to the shelves. In the evening a food bank van collected 60 buns for its weekend parcels. A dozen pigeons waited outside the door for crumbs. The till roll prints every price in cents rather than dollars. How many buns are left on the shelves?

On Monday morning a joinery workshop cut 194 planks, and every plank yielded 6 slats. Later that morning 1083 slats were used up building flat-pack shelving kits. In the afternoon a supplier delivered 70 more slats, and the foreman rejected 42 that had warped in the damp. In the evening the owner ordered a second batch identical to what was in the store, so the store ended up holding 2 times its late-afternoon count. The workshop's band saw is 3 years old. How many slats are in the store now?

A summer camp owns 138 tents, but 15 of them were torn in a storm and taken out of service. Every tent that is still usable sleeps 2 campers. A further 74 campers are staying in the wooden cabins by the lake. Each camper at the site is issued 6 meal tickets for the week, and every meal ticket can be exchanged for 8 tokens at the canteen. The lake is 3 kilometres across at its widest point. How many tokens could the campers claim altogether?

On Monday morning a nursery school took delivery of 207 boxes of crayons, and each box held 9 crayons. Before lunch a parent donated 70 loose crayons to the same basket. During the afternoon the children carried 1664 crayons off to the classrooms. In the evening the staff threw away 21 crayons that had been worn down to stubs. How many crayons are left in the basket?

A fruit stall opened the day with 14 crates of strawberries, and a café bought 4 crates whole before the market filled up. The stallholder unpacked the crates she still had, finding 5 punnets in each one, and set them all on the table. She sold 43 punnets during the morning rush. A fresh delivery then left the table holding twice as many punnets as it had held just after the rush. A neighbouring grower added 65 punnets of his own to the same table. The stall's price board is written in cents rather than dollars. How many punnets are on the table?

Nora had 17 boxes of wool in the loft with 9 balls in each box. She used 81 balls making a blanket for the winter fair. Her friend Hugo, who knits far less than Nora does, unwound every ball she had left into 3 shorter lengths for a beginners' workshop. The class got through 63 of those lengths on the first evening. The village hall costs 30 dollars an hour to hire. How many lengths of wool are left?

A furniture repair shop had 41 wooden stools waiting for attention. 8 of them were beyond saving and were broken up for firewood, and a customer collected 24 that had already been mended. A house clearance then brought in 77 more stools that needed work. The joiner unscrewed all 6 legs from every stool in the shop and stacked the loose legs into bundles of 6. The shop's van holds 20 stools at a time. How many bundles of legs did the joiner stack?

Priya's bookshop had 221 second-hand novels on the trolley one week, and a customer donated 27 more. She sold 93 of them at the weekend market and sent 109 to a charity shop, then pulled 16 off the trolley because pages were missing. Her business partner Sam matched what was left exactly with novels from his own store, so the shop's total became 2 times the trolley's count, even though Sam keeps less stock overall than Priya does. Every novel in the shop was then given 3 promotional bookmarks. The shop's ledger counts single novels rather than boxed sets. How many bookmarks were used?

A youth club was given 130 tickets for a football match and kept half of them for its own members, passing the rest to a partner club. 57 of the club's tickets were claimed on the first evening. A sponsor then sent the club 55 more tickets, and the stadium's community office added a further 63. The club's noticeboard lists tickets one by one rather than in whole blocks. How many tickets does the youth club have left to give out?

The hostel laundry counted 158 clean towels on the shelf on Wednesday. Housekeeping returned 11 towels that had never been used, and a supplier delivered 57 fresh ones. The manager threw out 23 towels that had gone threadbare and sent 51 across to the hostel's other branch. A dozen guests were waiting in the lobby while she counted. The laundry's stock sheet is written in single towels rather than in bales. How many towels are on the shelf now?

On Monday morning a dairy round set off with 130 bottles of milk on the float. A depot worker had added 12 bottles just before the driver, Femi, pulled away. Femi delivered 45 bottles on the first street. At midday his colleague Rosa, who runs a shorter round than Femi does, handed him 11 bottles left over from her own float, and in the afternoon the depot topped him up with 38 more. In the evening the dairy credited 8 loyalty points for every bottle still on Femi's float. How many loyalty points were credited?

Nadia and Ivo run a ribbon workshop together. Nadia measured out 188 metres of ribbon and divided it equally between the 2 benches, and Ivo, who works the slower bench, took one of those shares. Every metre on Ivo's bench was cut into 8 short lengths. Each short length was folded into 3 loops for a rosette. The binding machine takes 2 loops at a time and makes one bind for each pair, and every bind is fastened with 3 stitches. Each stitch uses 7 centimetres of thread. How many centimetres of thread did Ivo's bench use?

A model railway club stored its track in 20 boxes, with 5 pieces of track in every box. 20 pieces were found warped and thrown out, and 52 were sold on to another club. The club then bought 6 metal joining pins for every piece of track still in the store, and a spare tin in the cupboard already held 16 loose pins. A dozen members turned up to the Tuesday meeting. How many pins does the club have now?

Ivan's phone repair shop had 221 screen protectors in the drawer, and a sales rep left another 48 on his counter. The shop sold 71 of them over the weekend. His business partner Dolores, whose branch keeps less stock than Ivan's does, took 90 for her own counter across town. Every protector left in Ivan's drawer was then packed with 3 cleaning wipes ready for sale. The shop's stock system counts single protectors rather than sealed boxes. How many cleaning wipes were packed?

The stadium is divided into 109 blocks, every block has 7 rows, and every row holds 8 seats. At Saturday's match each seat holder was handed 5 raffle tickets on the way in. Half of all the tickets handed out were entered into the first draw of the evening. Each ticket in that first draw earned its holder 5 loyalty points. How many loyalty points were earned in the first draw?

On Wednesday morning a florist had 99 roses standing in the cold bucket. Before noon 37 of them went into a wedding bouquet. In the early afternoon a grower delivered 17 more roses to the shop. Later that afternoon she tied every rose in the bucket into a posy with 3 sprigs of fern beside it. In the evening she noticed that each sprig of fern carries 9 small leaflets. How many leaflets are on the fern in her posies?

On Monday morning a flooring firm had 134 boxes of underlay stacked in the yard, and a lorry brought 31 more before lunch. In the afternoon the fitters checked the stack and found that every box holds 4 packs. In the early evening they opened the packs and found 2 rolls inside each pack, and every roll measures 3 metres. The firm's van was serviced 5 weeks ago. How many metres of underlay does the firm have in the yard?

A textile mill wove 142 rolls of cloth, and each roll was cut into 9 metres of fabric. A supplier added 51 metres left over from an earlier batch. Every metre in the store was then cut into 7 badge patches. Customer orders took 6946 patches out of the store, and a parcel returned by a school put 32 patches back. How many patches are in the store now?

On Saturday morning a bakery took 110 pies out of the oven. A dropped tray ruined 10 of them before they had even cooled. Before lunch a café collected 45 pies, and in the early afternoon a caterer named Rita took 31, which was more than her colleague Sam collected later that afternoon when he came for 19. In the evening the staff ate 4 pies between them. Every pie still on the rack was then cut into 4 slices for the Sunday market. The bakery runs 6 ovens. How many slices were cut for the market?

On Sunday morning a community kitchen cooked 82 pots of soup, and each pot filled 3 vacuum flasks. Before noon a neighbouring café donated 56 filled flasks to the same trolley. During the afternoon 60 flasks were handed out at the night shelter. In the evening a late delivery brought 13 more flasks to the kitchen door. The volunteers' rota is written in minutes rather than in hours. How many flasks does the kitchen have?

On Friday morning a park ranger counted 101 saplings in the nursery bed, and 39 more arrived from the depot before ten o'clock. During the late morning all the saplings were shared equally among the park's 5 planting teams. In the afternoon the first team was handed 55 extra saplings from the store shed. In the early evening a school group gave that same team 79 saplings they had grown themselves, and just before dark the ranger added 75 more to the team's pile. How many saplings does the first team have?
